source_text:
domain define-non-collapse-evidence "Define non-collapse evidence classification"
profile declarative-function-v1
owner cyberalchemy-define-owner
logic sfol-v1

schema NonCollapseEvidenceFacts:
  relation: string pattern "^(distinct|related|collapsed|unresolved|unsupported)$"
  difference_present: boolean

schema NonCollapseEvidenceDecision:
  status: string pattern "^(accept|block)$"
  repair_focus: string pattern "^(none|evidence|collapsed|unresolved)$"
  authority_effect: string const "none"

mapping NonCollapseEvidenceAccepted:
  ontology "ALCH-DEFINE-NON-COLLAPSE-EVIDENCE-ACCEPTED"
  meaning "Accept a rationale-backed distinct or related term-pair classification."
  target NonCollapseEvidenceDecision
  field status = "accept"
  field repair_focus = "none"
  field authority_effect = "none"

mapping NonCollapseEvidenceInvalid:
  ontology "ALCH-DEFINE-NON-COLLAPSE-EVIDENCE-INVALID"
  meaning "Block an unsupported term relation or a relation without an operational difference."
  target NonCollapseEvidenceDecision
  field status = "block"
  field repair_focus = "evidence"
  field authority_effect = "none"

mapping NonCollapseEvidenceCollapsed:
  ontology "ALCH-DEFINE-NON-COLLAPSE-EVIDENCE-COLLAPSED"
  meaning "Block a pair explicitly classified as collapsed."
  target NonCollapseEvidenceDecision
  field status = "block"
  field repair_focus = "collapsed"
  field authority_effect = "none"

mapping NonCollapseEvidenceUnresolved:
  ontology "ALCH-DEFINE-NON-COLLAPSE-EVIDENCE-UNRESOLVED"
  meaning "Block a pair whose operational distinction remains unresolved."
  target NonCollapseEvidenceDecision
  field status = "block"
  field repair_focus = "unresolved"
  field authority_effect = "none"

rule NonCollapseEvidenceHasDefect:
  ontology "ALCH-DEFINE-NON-COLLAPSE-EVIDENCE-HAS-DEFECT"
  meaning "The relation is unsupported or its difference statement is absent."
  condition input.relation == "unsupported" or input.difference_present == false

rule NonCollapseEvidenceIsCollapsed:
  ontology "ALCH-DEFINE-NON-COLLAPSE-EVIDENCE-IS-COLLAPSED"
  meaning "A valid evidence record declares that the two terms collapse."
  condition input.relation == "collapsed" and input.difference_present

rule NonCollapseEvidenceIsUnresolved:
  ontology "ALCH-DEFINE-NON-COLLAPSE-EVIDENCE-IS-UNRESOLVED"
  meaning "A valid evidence record leaves the two-term distinction unresolved."
  condition input.relation == "unresolved" and input.difference_present

rule NonCollapseEvidenceIsAccepted:
  ontology "ALCH-DEFINE-NON-COLLAPSE-EVIDENCE-IS-ACCEPTED"
  meaning "A valid evidence record classifies the pair as distinct or related."
  condition (input.relation == "distinct" or input.relation == "related") and input.difference_present

result EvaluateNonCollapseEvidence:
  ontology "ALCH-DEFINE-EVALUATE-NON-COLLAPSE-EVIDENCE"
  meaning "Classify the semantic posture of one structurally located term pair."
  when NonCollapseEvidenceHasDefect yield NonCollapseEvidenceInvalid
  when NonCollapseEvidenceIsCollapsed yield NonCollapseEvidenceCollapsed
  when NonCollapseEvidenceIsUnresolved yield NonCollapseEvidenceUnresolved
  when NonCollapseEvidenceIsAccepted yield NonCollapseEvidenceAccepted

endpoint DefineNonCollapseEvidence:
  target node-http
  runtime node>=26.8.1
  method POST
  path "/define/non-collapse-evidence"
  input NonCollapseEvidenceFacts
  output NonCollapseEvidenceDecision
  result EvaluateNonCollapseEvidence
  auth-env DEFINE_LANGUAGE_GATE_TOKEN
  max-bytes 16384
  timeout-ms 1000
  error-status 422
  status accept 200
  status block 422
